people.imagined: In the practice yard, mid-sentence, he turns his head toward the pines on the hill, hearing something longer than the primer says.
people.subject: The moment: in a practice yard he stops mid-word and turns his head sharply toward the trees, mouth a little open, listening. Face: thin, sensitive and boyish, seventeen, large wide dark eyes gone distant, a long nose, a soft parted mouth, a smudge of pine sap on his forehead. Hair: black, a little untidy, bound in a small knot with a wooden pine-twig hairpin. Body: skinny, a long thin neck, bony shoulders. Clothing: an outer disciple's robe of pale bark-cream silk with a pine-green collar embroidered with pine needles, a little short at the wrists because he has grown, a thin green cord sash. Hands and objects: one hand raised halfway, fingers spread, asking for quiet. Power: faint green light and a few glowing pine needles drift toward him from the trees, as if the forest were answering. Background: dark tall pines on a hill above a roof line, mist among them, blurred. Light: cool silver-green light from the upper left. Expression: calm, honest, far away, listening.

people.imagined: Caught on the way back from the fallen pines, chewing a slab of the pale fungus she was meant to deliver, she insists the trunk was bare.
people.subject: The moment: caught on a forest path with her cheek full, she holds up half a slab of pale fungus and smiles guiltily at the viewer. Face: round, rosy and merry, about twenty, full cheeks with one bulging, bright dark eyes, a dimple, a crumb of pale fungus on her lower lip. Hair: black, in a loose bun pinned with a small wooden pine-twig hairpin, a wisp over one eye. Body: plump and comfortable. Clothing: an outer disciple's robes of soft pine-green and cream silk, the collar embroidered with tiny pine needles, the sleeves gathered up with green ribbons; a small gourd at her sash; a woven basket of pale fungus slabs on her hip. Hands and objects: a bitten slab of pale fungus in her right hand, the basket in her left. Power: a few tiny green motes of light drift around the basket, the fungus faintly glowing like the spirit-herb it is. Background: a dim pine forest floor with fallen trunks furred in moss and glowing bracket fungus. Light: soft dappled green-gold light from the upper left. Expression: guilty, delighted, unrepentant.

people.imagined: The riverbank below the pine palace, evening; he tilts his head as if hearing a sound behind him, and the pines on the hill are answering.
people.subject: The moment: at a riverbank at evening, he stands with his head tilted a little, as if listening to a sound behind him. Face: long, kind and weathered, about fifty-five, a tall man's gentle stoop, calm green-brown eyes, a soft mouth, a long thin grey-black beard. Hair: long, grey at the temples, held by a jade pine-twig hairpin, a few strands lifting in the breeze. Clothing: the undyed listening robe of a head of the pine palace: flowing layers of pale bark-cream silk under a grey-green gauze over-robe, the collars and hems embroidered with pine needles and wind-curls, a pine-green sash with a green jade pine-cone pendant. Hands and objects: big, ferryman's hands folded quietly in front of him; a small bronze censer hangs from his sash, a thread of green smoke rising from it. Power: a soft green light moves through the air around him like wind through needles, a few glowing pine needles drifting past his shoulders. Background: dark pines on a hill and a misty river, blurred. Light: soft green-gold evening light from the upper left, mist glowing around him. Expression: calm, humble, listening to something far away.
